thread:
elaine.chan: quick sync — want to align on the early-access pipeline for the next private deploy beta. goal: 6 partners, 4-week pilot each, get operational metrics + qualitative UX notes.

mike_r: sounds good. are we targeting existing Dedicated customers or new accounts?

elaine.chan: priority = mix. 3 existing customers (ops-savvy) + 3 new (fast feedback). we need a clear intake form and a runbook for onboarding.

sara_p: +1. suggest we gate by infra readiness (VPC + KMS) and a simple tech checklist. otherwise onboarding time explodes.

elaine.chan: agreed. draft checklist below — please call out missing items:
```
- infra: VPC peering, subnets, egress rules
- security: KMS integration, audit log access
- data: sample prompts, expected QPS patterns
- business: point-of-contact, success metric owner
- legal: basic NDA template + DPA check
```

mike_r: missing: telemetry hooks + eval harness. need us to ship a small prompt/labeling dashboard so partners can tag regressions.

daniel_k: onboarding ETA? i can allocate an eng onboarding buddy for 2 weeks per partner if we plan cohorts.

elaine.chan: timeline idea: recruit in week 1, tech onboarding week 2, pilot run weeks 3-6, wrap + debrief week 7. each partner assigned 1 PM (product) + 1 Eng buddy.

sara_p: success criteria proposal (must hit at least 3 to be "successful"):
- reliability: <1% error rate, 95th latency <= 250ms for target routes
- cost: per-1000-token cost within 1.2x of baseline hosted config
- quality: partner-rated throughput of feature (NPS-style) >= 7/10
- integration: deployment completed within 10 business days
- feedback: >= 10 canonical prompts flagged + repro steps

mike_r: love the concrete gates. add: we should monitor degradation regressions vs. model baseline and have automatic rollback policy in the runbook.

elaine.chan: yeah — add fallback policy + communication templates for customers if we need to rollback. also need an incentives plan: credits + prioritized support + co-marketing for referenceable partners.

daniel_k: legal signoff on NDA/DPA usually takes ~2 weeks. can we use a lightweight intake agreement to accelerate?

elaine.chan: product will work with legal to produce a fast-track intake agreement for pilot-only access. long-term contracts can follow after pilot success.

mike_r: channel for recruiting: account execs, solutions engineers, "early-access" interest form on site, and reach out to a couple of ecosystem partners (X, Y). i'll draft outreach copy.

elaine.chan: outreach copy + intake form need to be live by EOD Friday. eng/sre to confirm automated telemetry export and the labeling dashboard by next Wed. daniel: can you confirm eng buddy capacity?

daniel_k: yes, i'll confirm slots by EOD. tentatively can do 2 simultaneous pilots per sprint.

sara_p: one more thing — feedback cadence: weekly sync + shared doc + biweekly 30-min topical interviews (quality, latency, costs). capture all feedback in the eval board.

elaine.chan: perfect. i'll pull this into a short playbook and tag owners. final action items:
- mike_r: draft outreach + intake form (due Fri)
- daniel_k: confirm eng buddy capacity (due EOD)
- sara_p: create telemetry/eval list + dashboard requirements (due Wed)
- legal: (looped) review fast-track intake template

jordan-bot: reminder set: "EA pipeline playbook review" on calendar for 1795210000.

elaine.chan: thanks all — will share the playbook doc in #product and set a kickoff. :rocket:
